# Skytwin

> Synthetic star-field images with satellite streaks, instrument defects and an exact answer key for every frame.

Skytwin renders synthetic star-field images with satellite streaks and instrument defects, and writes an exact truth file for every frame: each star, streak and target with its position, flux, drawn path and signal-to-noise ratio. Instrument profiles hold every detector defect as a setting, skytwin-calibrate learns a profile from real frames, and skytwin-export turns frames into YOLO or COCO training sets.
